# gpupaas_virtual_machine_sku (Data Source)

A VM SKU (VmProfile): the images, sizes (presets), datacenters and options a `gpupaas_virtual_machine` created from it may use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_virtual_machine_sku" "small" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "vm-test"
}

output "images" {
  value = data.gpupaas_virtual_machine_sku.small.images
}

output "presets" {
  value = data.gpupaas_virtual_machine_sku.small.presets
}

output "public_ip_mode" {
  value = data.gpupaas_virtual_machine_sku.small.public_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project` (String) Project that holds the SKU, usually `system-catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (List of String) Orchestration agents that run the SKU's workflows. Provisioning fails with "no healthy agents found" when none of them is healthy; the list is not a health check.
- `boot_disk_increment` (Number) Boot disk sizes step by this many GB above the minimum.
- `boot_disk_max` (Number) Largest boot disk in GB.
- `boot_disk_min` (Number) Smallest boot disk in GB.
- `datacenters` (List of String) Datacenters VMs of this SKU may be placed in.
- `default_image` (String)
- `gpu_model` (String)
- `gpu_name` (String)
- `gpu_vendor` (String)
- `gpus_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SKU has GPUs; then `presets` are its GPU presets, otherwise its CPU presets.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `images` (List of String) Images VMs of this SKU may use.
- `instance_type` (String)
- `presets` (Attributes List) The sizes a VM of this SKU may be created with. Use a name as `spec.preset` of `gpupaas_virtual_machine`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--presets))
- `public_ip` (String) Public IP mode: `None`, `Always` or `Optional`.
- `shared_filesystem_enabled` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `template_version` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--presets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `presets`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String)
- `gpu` (String)
- `memory` (String)
- `name` (String)
